findings.detail: The filing reports unfunded debt investments with blank or negative cost values, so treating those cost formats as invalid creates a false alarm.

rationale: The raw June 30, 2024 schedule reports a negative total cost for unfunded debt investments: principal $153,674 thousand, cost $(586) thousand, and fair value $(492) thousand. Individual undrawn rows also show blank or negative cost cells in the Cost column. Because the source itself contains this unfunded-cost format, the aggregate fmt_cost warning is a rule-scope false alarm rather than a real extraction or normalization defect.
